claim: The UAE CMA public record lists APOLONIA CAPITAL FINANCIAL SERVICES L.L.C as active under CP-0001330.
The CMA detail response gives an established date of 23 October 2024 and shows the raw IssuePaid field as 500000.0; the response does not state a currency.
The CMA record lists Financial Consultations, Introduction and Promotion as active activities.
The website uses the name Apolonia Capital for Financial Consultation & Financial Analysis LLC and licence number 20200000300.
The captured CMA lookup for exact number 20200000300 returned no matching company detail; the reason is unresolved.
The regulatory disclaimer says wider investment banking, venture, asset management, wealth management, MFO and securities services are future plans and not currently licensed/offered by CMA.
The disclaimer says Apolonia does not hold client money/assets or provide custody unless separately authorised.
AIHL publicly describes itself as an ADGM-established holding and oversight entity, but no registration number or extract was obtained.
Odoo publicly identifies Apolonia Capital For Financial Consultation & Financial Analysis LLC as a customer reference and describes a customised CRM/operations platform.
Apolonia’s team page claims 250+ successfully completed mandates across the team’s combined careers.
The current Apolonia biography states Haarish is Managing Director and Head of Wealth Management & Multi-Family Office.
Apollo/public LinkedIn signals overlap Haarish with EWA from May 2025, while the EWA page shows one visible employee and Apollo’s organisation match points to an Egyptian logistics company.
The visible Apolonia Ventures and Securities Services routes, and two legacy query links, returned 404 in the browser capture.
No exact identity-matched public POSH, harassment, police, fraud, scam, lawsuit or court result was found in the bounded searches reviewed.
No named, client-consented closed transaction schedule or independently verified performance record was found in the reviewed public material.

The official public CMA page displays a Category 5 record and a notice narrowing the described derivatives/commodity/spot-FX brokerage, trading, portfolio-management and client-order activities; this is not evidence of an asset-management or fund-management licence.

Haarish’s public Apolonia joining announcement says he was joining Apolonia Capital as Head of Wealth Management & Multi-Family Office; this supports a public operating relationship but not a board or statutory-director role.

A later public article says Haarish represented Apolonia Capital at TYCOONS and leads Asset & Wealth Management and Family Office coverage; this supports continuing public representation but not legal authority or client-money permission.
The public Apolonia team page places Haarish in the operating team and lists other people separately as advisory-board members; no public board appointment for Haarish was found.

A public UAE Stories profile dated 20 February 2026 describes Haarish as CEO and Strategic Advisor at EWA; this is media/profile coverage, not an EWA registry, employment contract, ownership record or licence.
